messages:
kai: Planning a 90-day family sabbatical in Porto (Jun 1 -> Aug 29). Do I need to declare, and what's the impact on WFH stipend, payroll withholding, and health coverage? :portugal:
marie (People Ops): Yes please submit the temporary homebase form for stays >30 days. For ~90 days we loop Legal & Payroll. Form: https://hr.redwood.example/homebase-declare
kai: If I declare, does the monthly WFH stipend keep paying? is it prorated across months or paid full for months fully abroad?
omar (Finance): Stipend is prorated by calendar days each pay period. Full months abroad = full stipend; partial months are pro-rated. We'll confirm exact amounts after form submission.
kai: Portugal has different tax/social rules. Will Redwood require local payroll or a gross-up?
omar (Finance): For ~90-day EU stays we do a vendor review. Its case-by-case whether local payroll/withholding or gross-up is needed. Expect a payroll/tax review within 7 business days after you submit.
ben (Manager): Ben here  I approve the sabbatical schedule. Please include handoff notes for any on-call weeks.
kai: Thanks Ben. Also want to ship my dock and a second monitor to Porto. Is that allowed and covered?
marie (People Ops): International temporary shipping covered up to $150. Open an equipment ticket (attach the declare form). Customs/import taxes are typically employee responsibility unless manager pre-approves otherwise.
equip-bot: EQ-5567 created for international shipping. Please attach passport scan and Porto delivery address; insured option selected.
kai: Added passport and address to EQ-5567. Any changes to health insurance while I'm abroad?
marie (People Ops): Health benefits remain active for up to 90 days. Routine care abroad may be out-of-network; keep receipts for emergency care. If you plan to enroll with local providers or extend beyond 90 days well re-evaluate coverage.
kai: Will worker comp or 401k be impacted?
marie (People Ops): Worker comp stays tied to your permanent homebase for stays <182 days. Retirement contributions unchanged. Payroll will flag exceptions if needed.
kai: Manager signoff required for customs pre-approval?
ben (Manager): I approve equipment shipping and customs up to $200. Tag me on EQ-5567 for final sign-off.
hr-bot: "homebase-declare" form submitted by kai at 3065432109. Next steps: People Ops review -> Payroll/TAX vendor review (7 business days) -> Equipment EQ-5567 processing.
marie (People Ops): Thanks Kai  well post payroll's determination in-thread. Have a great trip! :wine_glass:
